title: Signature Global Rosalia — 2BHK Apartment in Sector 82

scenes.title: Welcoming Foyer & Shoe Nook
scenes.description: A bright entry foyer just inside the dark-wood B-904 front door, with a low shoe rack, a key hook board, and a rangoli motif painted on the light ceramic floor. The space opens straight ahead into the open-plan living room and branches to a common bathroom and the master bedroom, making it the natural hub of the home.
scenes.caption: Bright foyer with shoe nook
scenes.narration_script: As you step in through the main door, you're standing in the apartment's compact foyer. Drop your shoes on the rack to the side and hang your keys on the little board by the door. From here the home unfolds: directly ahead is the open living and dining space with its park-facing balcony, to your right a common bathroom, and a little further round, the master bedroom. Let's head into the living room first.

scenes.title: Sunlit Open-Plan Living Room
scenes.description: A relaxed Scandinavian living room with a sage-green sofa and armchair, a light wood TV unit, and a low coffee table set with a laptop and coffee. A ceiling fan and wall AC keep it cool, while curtained glass doors open to the park-facing balcony. The room flows seamlessly into the dining area and kitchen and connects onward to the master bedroom and entrance.
scenes.caption: Sage sofa, park-view balcony
scenes.narration_script: This is the heart of the home — an open-plan living room finished in calm whites and soft greens. Sink into the sage sofa with a coffee, or work from the laptop on the table. Notice how the balcony doors flood the space with daylight and how the kitchen and dining sit just to one side with no walls between them. From here you can step out to the balcony, wander into the kitchen, or head down to the master bedroom.

scenes.title: Compact Sage-Green Kitchen
scenes.description: A functional L-shaped kitchen with sage-green cabinetry, a granite countertop, a stainless steel fridge, a gas hob with a chimney hood, and an under-window sink with an RO water purifier. A washing-machine utility corner sits beside a glass door to the balcony. The open left side connects directly back to the dining table and living room.
scenes.caption: Sage cabinets, granite counter
scenes.narration_script: Step into the kitchen, an efficient L-shaped layout in soft sage green with a hard-wearing granite counter. There's a full-size fridge, a gas hob under the chimney, and a sink set below the window with an RO purifier alongside. The washing machine tucks into the utility corner by the balcony door. Because it's open-plan, the dining and living room are just a step away to your left.

scenes.title: Park-Facing Sit-Out Balcony
scenes.description: A generous open balcony with rattan lounge chairs and a small table, framed by an open view over treetops and neighbouring high-rises. A clothes-drying stand, potted plants, and a bicycle helmet give it a lived-in feel. Curtained glass sliding doors lead back into the living room.
scenes.caption: Rattan chairs, treetop view
scenes.narration_script: Out here on the balcony you get the apartment's best feature — a clear, park-facing outlook over the green and the skyline of New Gurgaon. Pull up one of the rattan chairs with your coffee, while the drying stand and planters handle everyday life. When you're ready, the sliding glass doors take you straight back into the living room.

scenes.title: Restful Master Bedroom
scenes.description: A calm master bedroom with a queen bed dressed in white and sage, twin bedside lamps, and a pale grey accent wall. It is well equipped with a wooden wardrobe, a low dresser, a window with light curtains, and a compact work desk and chair. An attached bathroom opens off one side and the main door leads back to the living and dining area.
scenes.caption: Sage-and-white master suite
scenes.narration_script: This is the master bedroom — restful and bright, with a queen bed against a soft grey accent wall and a lamp glowing on each side. There's a full wardrobe, a dresser, and a tidy little desk by the window for working from home. The attached bathroom is right here off the bed, and the main door opens back out to the living and dining space.

scenes.title: Mosaic-Tiled Family Bathroom
scenes.description: A clean bathroom with a granite-topped vanity and a large mirror, a wall-mounted toilet, and a curtained shower against a mosaic feature tile. Towel rails, a health faucet, and recessed shelving keep it practical. One door connects to the master bedroom and another opens back toward the entrance hall.
scenes.caption: Mosaic-tile shower, granite vanity
scenes.narration_script: Here's the family bathroom, shared between the hall and the master bedroom. A granite-topped vanity with a wide mirror sits opposite the wall-hung toilet, and the shower is set against a warm mosaic feature wall with its own curtain. It's compact but well finished. You can step back into the master bedroom on one side or out toward the entrance hall on the other.
